excluded_from_both: constant-effort metadata with no solve consumption
calculation_basis.literal_adapter_case: adds the exact C-150 authored local relative stiffness in parallel with P-130; retained only as an algebraic adapter mapping diagnostic, not a physically balanced whole-frame oracle
calculation_basis.physical_frame_case: excludes C-150 relative stiffness because its unresolved finite-end formulation produces an unbalanced global moment; this case establishes the objective frame/support/load reference without deciding audit D02
calculation_basis.unit_scope: explicit fixture-local SI only; no project-wide canonical conversion acceptance

interpretation_forks.direction_at_zero: OPEN only if a nonzero prior slip/reference is asserted; zero-reference static branch determines direction from returned displacement
interpretation_forks.incremental_history: OPEN: fixture has an initial state but no ordered load increments, committed slip/reference state, rollback rule, or prior converged load-step history
interpretation_forks.pressure: omitted by the selected pressure-free case; P5 owns pressure matrix
interpretation_forks.zero_reference_static: calculated branch; current-return normal and friction action solved simultaneously

literal_adapter_mapping_diagnostic.applicability: algebraic fixture-to-adapter mapping only; nonzero external moment-balance residual is the independently exposed D02 connector-formulation limitation
